item_01_dataset_provenance.evidence: UNB ISCX VPN-nonVPN 2016 archive (37 PCAPs, 13.2 GB, 11.98M pkts) verified against CIC Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity.

item_02_flow_reconciliation.evidence: 10,770 raw flows - 6,574 removed = 4,196 clean flows. 6,961 rule hits - 387 overlaps (LLMNR/SSDP/IGMP multicast) = 6,574 unique removed.

item_03_filtering_hygiene.evidence: Filters standard L3/L4 OS infrastructure chatter (DNS, LLMNR, NetBIOS, SSDP, Multicast). Legitimate application media preserved.

item_04_causal_feature_integrity.evidence: Early-5 features strictly adhere to packet arrival sequence (packets 1..5); zero future packet timestamps or sizes utilized.

item_05_capture_group_independence.evidence: 29 capture groups verified. Max folds per group = 1 across all splits (zero train/test group leakage).

item_06_group_imbalance_analysis.evidence: GRP_FTPS_DOWN_1 identified as holding 74.00% of Bulk Data. Re-evaluated LOGO without FTPS Down (Macro F1 = 0.5110).

item_07_fold_support_defect_resolution.evidence: Historical Fold 4 empty Bulk support discovered. Resolved via 29-fold LOGO (0.5734) and balanced 5-fold Seed 157 (0.5954).

item_08_ml_reproducibility.evidence: All 6 baseline architectures reproduced bit-exact down to 0.000000 difference across all metrics.

item_09_early_horizon_optimality.evidence: Early-5 proved superior under LOGO (0.5734) compared to Early-10 (0.5591), Early-15 (0.5457), and Early-20 (0.5465).

item_10_calibration_shift_discovery.evidence: Post-hoc Platt and Isotonic calibrators overfit training capture conditions under domain shift (Brier score degrades from 0.628 to 0.691).

item_11_confidence_aware_scheduling.evidence: Confidence threshold tau=0.55 selected from OOF CDF; demotes low-confidence flows to DRR queue, boosting Bulk goodput to 20.46 Mbps.

item_12_closed_loop_qos_simulation.evidence: Simulated across Low (50%), Moderate (85%), and High (125%) congestion; delay halved (65.8ms -> 30.6ms) and starvation eliminated (1.66 -> 19.7Mbps).

item_13_multi_seed_robustness.evidence: Statistical tests evaluated across 15 paired seeds; Shapiro-Wilk normality verified; Cohen's d effect sizes with 95% CIs reported.

item_14_dual_metric_sla_audit.evidence: 3GPP TS 23.501 origins labeled. Delay SLA met (<100ms), but 125% overload violates 1% loss SLA (3.43%), proving partial SLA compliance.

item_15_novelty_and_literature.evidence: Compared against 5 landmark prior works (Huang 2021, Draper-Gil 2016, Lotfollahi 2020, Aceto 2019, Taylor 2016); verified novelty positioning.
